title: governed-loop-v2 phase exit evidence
$comment: Machine form of the phase-N.json contract in evidence/README.md. The Executor writes evidence/phase-N.json every cycle — including not-yet-passing snapshots that loop-stop-gate.sh blocks on — so this schema validates STRUCTURE only (field presence, types, ledger_head_hash format, exit_criteria as criterion-id STRINGS) and deliberately does NOT pin the three pass/fail values (exit_criteria_met/validator_signoff true, test_results.failed 0); those are owned by the jq Stop gate, not the schema. additionalProperties is true so forward-compatible evidence is never rejected.

exit_criteria.description: Criterion ids for this phase (from workload.yaml), as written by the Executor.

exit_criteria_met.description: True iff every criterion exited 0. The Observer computes it; the stop gate requires it true.

validator_signoff.description: True only when the validator returned PASS this cycle AND every command exited 0. The stop gate requires it true.

failed.description: Failing-check count. The jq Stop gate (not this schema) requires failed==0 to close a phase; a mid-cycle snapshot may legitimately have failed>0, so the schema only requires the field, typed.

ledger_head_hash.description: Head hash of evidence/ledger.jsonl (sha256, lowercase hex).
